results.message: What did the Punic-speaking people out in the countryside believe?

voice_event.speaker: lpc
voice_event.text: We cannot tell you. Our whole record comes from two cities, and nearly all of it from two bishops. What lay beyond them -- the countryside, and the language many ordinary people spoke there, which was not Latin -- we do not carry in any detail. We know a bishop was given a people. He preached to them and baptized them, and when they failed it was not a problem he managed but a wound he carried. We know you were taught before you were washed. We told you what you were joining before you joined it. You said the creed back, and then we baptized you. That much we can say held in our own cities. Whether it held the same way in a village where Punic or Berber was spoken, our record does not say. We will not invent it to fill the silence.
